answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 150086 Country: India Title: I am giving my final exams please tell some dua and wazifah that I get pass in my exams. Question: I am giving my final exams please tell some dua and wazifah that I get pass in my exams. Answer ID: 150086 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 927/906/L=7/1438) Offer salah regularly and keep on supplicating Allah. Also keep on reading Ya Nasir ( يا ناصر ) extensively. In-shaAllah you shall qualify the exam. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
